noticias.titulo: How Costco Engineered the Perfect Gas Station
noticias.descripcion: Costco sells gas so cheap it barely breaks even on it — and now it's building massive standalone gas stations with no store attached. That's not a loss leader. For the average American driver, that discount alone pays for the membership fee by the end of the year. Which means the pump isn't a perk — it's the product.
